item.title: UK prime minister calls actions of Russian warship reckless but not sinister
item.description: UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer says the crew of a Russian warship of acted recklessly in firing a warning shots near a British yacht in the English Channel

item.title: Sudan’s young women return to international soccer as war and taboos linger
item.description: Sudan's under-17 women's national soccer team has made its first international appearance since civil war erupted in the country

item.title: UK military investigates after Russian warship fires warning shots near yacht in the Channel
item.description: A Russian warship has fired warning shots near a U.K.-registered pleasure yacht in the English Channel

item.title: Japan raises safety concern over Chinese destroyer's live-fire drills
item.description: Japanese officials have expressed concern after a Chinese navy destroyer conducted live-fire drills off one of Japan’s remote islands

item.title: Conflicts and energy shocks threaten progress against hunger, UN agency head warns
item.description: Conflicts and disruptions to global energy markets could push millions more people into hunger by driving up fuel, fertilizer and food costs

item.title: India tunnel disaster at a Himalayan hydropower project leaves 10 dead and 17 missing
item.description: A suspected gas explosion has caused a tunnel collapse at a hydropower project in India's Sikkim state, near the Chinese border, leaving at least 11 people dead and 14 missing
